_source.title: 隐藏开始页快速启动选项
_source.remarks.text.0: 隐藏开始页快速启动模块中的指定项
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意 1：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.2: 注意 2：本接口为私有化部署版本专用接口，如若在其它版本调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.items: 欲隐藏的快速启动项数组
_source.returns: 是否全部隐藏成功（若存在未知项或已隐藏的项则返回 `false`）

title: Hide start page quick start items
remarks.text.0: Hide the specified items in the quick start module of the start page
remarks.text.1: Note 1: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.2: Note 2: This API is dedicated to the private deployment edition. Calling it in other editions will always `throw Error`
params.items: Array of quick start items to hide
returns: Whether all items were hidden successfully (`false` is returned if unknown items or already-hidden items exist)
